description: A Rust workspace that publishes crates to crates.io and ships a built artifact. Versions live in [workspace.dependencies], which mixes runtime and development crates. A workspace bump is therefore a fix, and the repository names its development-only crates as chore.
The toolchain pin is exact and moves on its own branch. The cargo manager's own commit topic is overridden, so a header reads bump serde, not bump Rust crate serde.
osvVulnerabilityAlerts reads OSV, which carries RustSec entries GitHub's database lacks. Renovate marks the option experimental.
